name: zone_pressure_requests
description: Static pressure reset requests from one VAV zone. Output yPreReq is 3 when the airflow has been short of three_fraction of its setpoint, with the zone served, for at least persistence; else 2 when it has been short of two_fraction of its setpoint, with the zone served, for at least persistence; else 1 when it has been short of one_fraction of its setpoint, with the zone served, for at least persistence, or while the damper is open; else 0. The airflow is short of a fraction of its setpoint once (fraction times setpoint minus airflow) goes above 0, and stays short until that difference is no longer above minus flow_band. The zone is served once its airflow setpoint goes above served_flow, and stays served until the setpoint is no longer above served_flow minus served_band. The damper is open once its position goes above damper_open, and stays open until its position is no longer above damper_open minus damper_band. Timing at the edges: all thresholds are strict (a damper at exactly 0.95 is not open; a damper that is open closes at exactly 0.85). Each persistence count restarts whenever its condition (short and served) turns on again, and a condition already true at the first frame still has to last the full persistence.

params.name: one_fraction
params.meaning: Fraction of setpoint below which a lasting shortfall sends 1 request

params.name: two_fraction
params.meaning: Fraction of setpoint below which a lasting shortfall sends 2 requests

params.name: three_fraction
params.meaning: Fraction of setpoint below which a lasting shortfall sends 3 requests

params.name: flow_band
params.meaning: Release band on the shortfall conditions

params.name: persistence
params.meaning: How long a shortfall must last before it counts

params.name: served_flow
params.meaning: Airflow setpoint above which the zone counts as served

params.name: damper_open
params.meaning: Position above which the damper counts as open
